title: Famous Landmarks in Rome and New York
text:
The Colosseum is in Rome. It is very big and old. Many people visit it. It was a place for games long ago.

The Statue of Liberty is in New York. It is green. It holds a torch in its hand. It is a gift from France.

questions.text: What color is the Statue of Liberty?
Why do many people visit the Colosseum?
options: Because it is a famous old place
Because it is a new shop
Because it is under the sea

questions.text: What can we guess about the Statue of Liberty?
options: It is a gift from another country

vocabulary.definition: a light that you can hold in your hand
something that you give to someone

paragraph_translations: Колізей знаходиться в Римі. Він дуже великий і старий. Багато людей його відвідують. Давно це було місце для ігор.
Статуя Свободи знаходиться в Нью-Йорку. Вона зелена. Вона тримає факел у руці. Це подарунок від Франції.
